summary: Tested Priority 2 (Critical Power / W' Balance, age-adjusted decay + pre-emptive intervention). Backend: existing regression suite test_iter112_struggle_and_debrief.py re-confirmed 4/4 PASS against the public preview URL. New test_iter117_wprime_predictive.py (5/5 PASS) covers: POST /api/coach/cue with cue_kind='struggle', struggle_reasons=['w_prime_low'], preemptive=true, time_to_depletion_sec=45 -> 200 valid cue (new predictive branch); the same struggle cue WITHOUT the two new optional fields -> still 200 (backward compat); a minimal/legacy live cue with no struggle fields at all -> still 200; Age persistence via PUT/GET /api/rider/profile; Max HR persistence via POST/GET /api/activities/ftp. Frontend: logged in as demo@roujaune.app, started a live 'Threshold Intervals' workout -> HUD loaded with ticking ELAPSED/CALORIES/DISTANCE telemetry, ERG testIDs (bc-erg, bc-erg-up, bc-erg-down) present and tappable, pause/end controls present, ended the ride via the 'End this ride?' dialog (Save Ride) -> Workout Summary screen rendered cleanly with no red-screen/crash. Sanity-checked Profile screen: Age (62) displays correctly and is editable via the 'Edit rider profile' modal, matching the backend value confirmed by the persistence test. Code review of struggle.ts/useStruggleMonitor.ts/workout.tsx confirms remainingIntervalSec (activeSeg.remaining) and age are correctly threaded into the engine, and onStruggle correctly branches on s.preemptive to build the coach payload (preemptive + time_to_depletion_sec). As flagged in the review request, forcing the actual pre-emptive W' trigger (sustained power > CP long enough to drop W'bal < 15% AND predict zero before interval end) through the simulated web-preview telemetry within a short test window was not achievable -- reported as untestable via current tooling (not a failure), consistent with the same limitation noted for the Priority 1 ERG-failure gate in the prior round.

issues: Max HR does not appear to have a dedicated, rider-facing input anywhere in the explored screens (Profile 'Edit rider profile' modal only has Weight/Age/Gender/capability/location; Settings has coach/equipment/wheel prefs; Benchmark Workouts shows benchmark test results but no direct Max HR field). The backend setting (settings.app.max_hr, read/written via /api/activities/ftp) works correctly and persists, but there is no visible UI to set it directly -- it may only ever be set by an FTP/HR benchmark test result. This is a pre-existing gap unrelated to this PR (age is the field actually used by the new W' age-adjustment math in struggle.ts, not max_hr, so this does not block Priority 2), but worth flagging since the review's sanity-check line mentioned 'Max HR and Age' together.

verified_working: NEW pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter117_wprime_predictive.py -> 5/5 PASSED: preemptive struggle cue with new fields (200 + valid cue), struggle cue WITHOUT new optional fields (200, backward compatible), minimal legacy live cue (200), age persists via PUT/GET /api/rider/profile, max_hr persists via POST/GET /api/activities/ftp.

Code review: struggle.ts updateWbal() age-adjustment reads exactly per spec -- baseTau scaled by progressMult (up to +80% by ~60min) and ageMult (+2%/yr over 50, capped +50% at 75+), recovery slowed (never sped up) as ride progresses / for older riders -- matches the 'aggressively slow down W' reconstitution' requirement.

Code review: timeToDepletionSec = wBal / (curPower - cp) when curPower>cp else null; preemptive = lowWPrime (wPrimePct<0.15) && timeToDepletionSec!=null && remainingIntervalSec>0 && timeToDepletionSec<remainingIntervalSec -- matches the exact spec equation and the 15%/interval-end gate.

Code review: useStruggleMonitor.ts threads o.age into StruggleConfig and o.remainingIntervalSec into each pushed sample; workout.tsx passes remainingIntervalSec: activeSeg?.remaining ?? 0 and branches onStruggle on s.preemptive (message text + coach cue payload with preemptive/time_to_depletion_sec) exactly as described in the review's file references.

Live indoor workout (web preview, simulated telemetry): loads correctly, ELAPSED/CALORIES/DISTANCE tick upward, ERG testIDs (bc-erg, bc-erg-up, bc-erg-down) present and tappable (ERG intensity panel shows 100%), pause/end controls present, End-ride dialog (Save Ride/Abandon Ride/Resume) works, Save Ride -> Workout Summary screen renders cleanly with no crash/red-screen.
Profile screen: Age field (62) displays and is editable via 'Edit rider profile' modal, consistent with the backend-persisted value verified in the pytest run.
action_items: None blocking. Optional/nice-to-have: consider exposing a direct Max HR input in Profile/Settings (currently only settable server-side via /api/activities/ftp, no UI found) -- low priority since the new W' age-adjustment math itself only consumes rider age, not max_hr.

The pre-emptive W' intervention (power sustained above CP long enough to drop W'bal<15% AND predict zero before interval end) could not be forced through the simulated web-preview telemetry in the available test window -- same limitation as the Priority 1 mechanical-failure gate; reported as untestable via current tooling, not a failure. User's own Node-script math verification (age/progression-scaled tau + 3 time-to-depletion scenarios) is a reasonable substitute given this constraint.
critical_code_review_comments: struggle.ts: CP is correctly kept equal to FTP as documented scope note (this.cp = cfg.ftp || 250; updated on setConfig when ftp changes) -- no separate CP-testing protocol introduced, matching the stated out-of-scope note.

New CoachCueRequest fields (preemptive: bool=False, time_to_depletion_sec: Optional[float]=None) are additive with safe defaults -- confirmed via test that omitting them entirely still returns 200, so no breaking change for older clients/tests.

routes/coach.py predictive-W' instruction branch is correctly gated on req.preemptive AND 'w_prime_low' in req.struggle_reasons, falling back to the existing general-struggle wording otherwise -- clean, non-overlapping branch logic.
Minor: estimateWPrime() uses a flat 70x FTP heuristic with a 9000J floor -- reasonable placeholder since no dedicated W' testing protocol exists yet (consistent with the CP=FTP proxy scope note).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of reachable flows passed (live workout load/telemetry/ERG toggle/end-ride/summary, Age display+persistence); pre-emptive W' visual trigger untestable via current simulated-telemetry tooling (expected per review_request, same as prior round's ERG gate)

seed_data_creation: None. Test-modified rider age/max_hr values were restored to their original values within the same test run (no residual test data left behind).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Priority 2 (CP/W' balance, age-adjusted decay, pre-emptive intervention) is verified correct at the backend-contract and code-review level; live-workout and Priority-1 regressions are unaffected. The only remaining gap is visually observing the actual pre-emptive 'urgent audio encouragement' toast firing live in the UI, which requires either a way to inject a precise synthetic power-above-CP stream sustained long enough to deplete W'bal<15% with a predicted zero-crossing before interval end, or a native/BLE-simulator rig -- not available in the current web-preview tooling. If Priority 3 of the physiological model is implemented next, re-run backend/tests/test_iter117_wprime_predictive.py and test_iter112_struggle_and_debrief.py together as the standing regression baseline for the struggle/coach-cue contract.
rca_of_issue: No bug found. This is an additive feature (new optional CoachCueRequest fields + new predictive branch in the struggle/safety prompt builder + age-adjusted W' recovery tau in struggle.ts). All changed files reviewed line-by-line match the Priority 2 spec (age-adjusted decay formula, Time-to-Depletion equation, 15%-and-predicted-before-interval-end gate) exactly, and backward compatibility for older payloads (missing preemptive/time_to_depletion_sec) is confirmed by test. No RCA needed.
